resolved_diagnostics.finding: Prismheart construction assigned a conditional untyped Array to Array[Vector3], then pose updates encountered the unconstructed mesh.
resolved_diagnostics.fix: Construct PackedVector3Array explicitly. Final startup and native visual assertions pass; no masking nil guard or geometry change.

resolved_diagnostics.finding: The new camera wait omitted36 frames of motion observations, so the next sample combined normal companion movement and failed the existing .35m per-observation limit.
resolved_diagnostics.fix: Observe all36 camera-transition physics ticks with the existing recorder. No previous-position reset, threshold increase, navigation or AI change. Final complete city traversal is required to pass.

resolved_diagnostics.finding: Validate every configurable landmark tower height, including finite lower/upper bounds.
resolved_diagnostics.fix: Require each height finite within35–45m. Negative-data tests clone configurations and preserve the shared live resource.

resolved_diagnostics.finding: An older retained batching fixture measured the Collection Hall with the default8m cells, while its shipped ready-time policy has used12m cells since the prior home-room stage.
resolved_diagnostics.fix: Test the actual Sanctuary8m and Hall12m policies. The original minimum80 savings remains unchanged; Hall saves104 native renderable meshes(321 to217), with collider/floor/exclusion assertions preserved. No production batching change.

resolved_diagnostics.finding: An older retained camera assertion expected the removed low crystal obstruction at y2.8–3.8, rather than the intentionally raised Prismheart.
resolved_diagnostics.fix: Check the canonical physical camera envelope, its authored lower plane, actual native sphere clearance before the hit surface and identical behavior across presets. The player-space body ray and all other scene checks remain.

manual_android_tests: Import the root project with Godot4 Android editor and launch the Sanctuary; verify no resource/script errors and safe landscape UI.
Inspect enlarged walls, four landmark towers, giant trees, blue/gold booths and rotating Prismheart from both camera perspectives by day and night.
Walk all six booth approaches with Guardian/Mystic; open the same DEMO market through each actual mobile INTERACT button and verify honest TEST currency labels.
Verify original dungeon/home/pet/practice/frontier portals, return spawns, merchant/NPC services and both terrace routes remain readable and reachable.
Exercise Low/Medium/High quality, reduced motion/effects, zero particle density, focus loss, safe areas, touch scrolling and actual device keyboard.
Verify inventory, equipment, acquired trophies/pets, companions, home rooms and secured Depthmarks persist after restart and dungeon extraction.
Measure native Android frame time, memory, battery and sustained temperature.30/60FPS are unverified device goals, not results of this gate.
